objective: Resolve the currently observed CPVS 730k derivation and ALeRCE TAP acquisition blockers without weakening scientific release gates.

baseline.description: Scientific validation contracts are executable, but the heavy gate is blocked by an ALeRCE TAP parser failure, CPVS 730k derivation mismatch, and a CI lifecycle-record omission.

correctness.reason: Live source-backed rerun is required to establish the corrected CPVS membership and ALeRCE acquisition results.

reliability.reason: The blocker fixes must be validated by GitHub Actions on the complete source-backed workflow.

reproducibility.reason: The corrected source-selection contract must first produce immutable evidence in CI.

scientific_validity.reason: The scientific gate remains blocked until the source-backed evidence passes.

measurement.trade_off: No scientific assertion is relaxed; failures remain release-blocking until independently evidenced.

evidence: Previous heavy validation observed 741,787 CPVS candidates before quality-flag filtering, while the published target is 730,184.
The same run reported non-zero g/r quality flags among SNR-eligible observations, providing a concrete selection-semantics hypothesis to validate.
The current ALeRCE TAP query failed at the server parser on the ORDER BY clause.
validation.blocker: Live heavy scientific validation has not yet re-run on this correction branch.

root_causes: CPVS derivation treated every SNR-qualified exposure as a valid detection without enforcing zero quality flags.
ALeRCE query used a server-side ordering form rejected by the current TAP parser.
The pull request changed meaningful files without carrying a cumulative lifecycle record.

findings: Published benchmark counts must be reproduced from the source's detection-quality semantics, not from SNR alone.
Live TAP adapters must be tested against the provider's current ADQL parser while retaining deterministic selection semantics.
Scientific recovery changes must carry their cumulative lifecycle record from the first reviewable commit.

open_blockers: CPVS 730,184 exact derivation has not yet been verified on the correction branch.
ALeRCE source-backed acquisition has not yet passed on the correction branch.
Historical ALeRCE snapshot drift remains unresolved and is intentionally not weakened.
